title: Baladatube.xyz
tagline: A decentralized social network to connect music artists and fans. Allow artists publish their music albums as NFTs and other few social network features like follow, comments and profiles.
description: A decentralized social network to connect music artists with their fan base, allow mint/listen NFT music albums and songs, help spread their work to new fans, create a place to people discover new musics and support their prefered artists, allow artists stream live shows leveraging zora network gas efficiency, modular architecture and instant/cross-platform royalties features.
how_its_made: Baladatube.xyz is a decentralized and permissionless social media network built with Lens Protocol on POLYGON network. It integrate ZORA marketplace protocol leveraging zora network gas efficiency, modular architecture and instant/cross-platform royalties features in the music NFT space. For NFT data storage (metadata, images, mp3's and other assets) it integrate NFT.storage service and NEUME protocol to crawl, index and serve NFT music data. It integrate LIVEPEER to allow musicians promote their music using livestreaming shows and video on demand. Allow musicians share exclusive/private content to their followers using LIT protocol to encrypt and store any content they want share with their fanbase. Using Tailwind CSS and Next.JS to design the frontend and the backend is built using a TS/Rust mix.
